description: BC Wildfire Wildland Urban Interface 1km Buffer is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by BC Wildfire Service. The 1km Buffer dataset denotes the eligible area of the Wildland Urban Interface (WUI), for the purpose of the FireSmart Community Funding & Supports program (FCFS), that qualifies for the criteria for funding activities. It is defined as a maximum of one kilometer from the structure density class greater than 6. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher BC Wildfire Service. Its tags are BCWS, WUI, WUI 1km, Wildland Urban Interface, forest fire. It offers 5 resource(s) in FGDB, KML, MULTIPLE, OTHER, WMS. The portal shows 2023-06-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
